part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the `shouldComponentUpdate` override that `useReducer` installs on hook components (hooks/src/index.js:289).

**Root cause:** When a child sets state and then undoes it in the same tick, the pending `_nextValue` ends up equal to the committed `_value`, so the SCU computed `shouldUpdate === false` and returned `false` — discarding the render even when the parent had passed new props. The bailout is only safe when the component itself is the root of the update (in that case the vnode is shallow-copied and props are referentially equal); when the update trickles down from a parent, props differ and must not be ignored.
